name: Maltego
one_line_description: Graph-based OSINT and cyber investigation platform with transforms across 120+ data providers.
notable: Acquired/backed via Charlesbank (2023); ~$100M growth funding announced; ISO 27001 certified.

name: ShadowDragon Horizon
one_line_description: Enterprise OSINT platform (Horizon + SocialNet) for collection, identity enrichment, monitoring, and link analysis.
notable: SOC 2 Type II; positions strongly on ethical/unattributed collection.

name: Social Links
one_line_description: SOCMINT and OSINT suite (Crimewall, API) spanning 500+ social, messenger, blockchain, and dark-web sources.
notable: Legal entities in US, Netherlands (Amstelveen), and Latvia; Frost & Sullivan OSINT leader mentions.

name: Blackdot Videris
one_line_description: End-to-end OSINT investigation platform (Videris) with search, network visualization, automation, and audit trails.
notable: UK-built; strong emphasis on evidence packages for investigators.

name: Skopenow
one_line_description: AI-assisted OSINT research suite combining people, crime, news, and media data with link analysis.
notable: NYC-based investigative platform marketed to LE and insurance/fraud teams.

name: Cobwebs Technologies (PenLink)
one_line_description: Web investigation platform for AI-assisted monitoring, social/deep/dark-web research, and graph analysis.
notable: Joined PenLink (July 2023) to expand digital investigative platform; Israeli roots / US commercial presence.

name: i2 Analyst's Notebook
one_line_description: Long-standing visual analysis desktop/subscription platform for turning disparate data into actionable intelligence graphs.
notable: 30+ year LE staple; now offered via subscription bundles with connectors.

name: Palantir Gotham/Foundry
one_line_description: Enterprise data integration and analysis platforms used by intelligence and large investigations (not a pure OSINT collector).
notable: Controversial among privacy advocates; requires customer-fed data; high cost/complexity.

name: OSINT Industries
one_line_description: Web OSINT search for email, phone, username, name, and crypto wallets across 1500+ sources with timeline/map views.
notable: Claims 5000+ LE departments; privacy-first (no stored search results) messaging; credit-based pricing.

name: Pipl
one_line_description: Enterprise identity intelligence / fraud risk suite (Search, Trust, Elements) built on a long-running global identity graph.
notable: Shifted from consumer people-search box to sales-led enterprise fraud/identity products.

name: Spokeo
one_line_description: US-focused people-search SaaS for name, phone, address, email, and social profile lookups from public records.
notable: Consumer-oriented; privacy/opt-out debates common in people-search sector.

name: Babel Street
one_line_description: Enterprise/government multilingual risk and identity intelligence platform (agentic AI positioning).
notable: Strong gov/LE footprint; Reston VA area HQ listings.

name: Dataminr
one_line_description: Real-time AI event, threat, and risk intelligence from public data streams (news/social/sensors).
notable: Leader for crisis/alert velocity vs deeper narrative analysis tools.

name: Brandwatch
one_line_description: Enterprise social listening and consumer intelligence platform (volume and integrations focus).
notable: Part of Cision group; more marketing/PR than classic investigative OSINT.

name: Meltwater
one_line_description: Media, social, and consumer intelligence platform for PR and brand monitoring.
notable: Norwegian roots / public-company history; overlaps OSINT for reputation use cases.

name: Pulsar Platform
one_line_description: Audience- and narrative-led social intelligence platform for communities and story attribution.
notable: Often compared with Dataminr/Brandwatch on methodology fit rather than raw volume.

name: Recorded Future
one_line_description: Large commercial threat intelligence platform covering open web, dark web, actor context, DRP, and third-party risk.
notable: Premium enterprise pricing; Insikt Group human analysis + Intelligence Graph.

name: Flashpoint
one_line_description: Intelligence platform (Ignite) for cyber, fraud, and physical/national-security risk from adversary and underground sources.
notable: Audax PE majority investment (2021); NYC-based.

name: Cybersixgill (Bitsight)
one_line_description: Automated CTI from deep/dark web forums, markets, and invite-only chats with SaaS/API delivery.
notable: Acquired by Bitsight (deal announced/completed late 2024).

name: Flare
one_line_description: Identity-first CTI and dark-web/Telegram/stealer-log monitoring with remediation-oriented workflows.
notable: Montreal HQ; strong mid-market positioning vs enterprise TIP giants.

name: ZeroFox
one_line_description: External cybersecurity / digital risk platform combining dark-web intel, asset discovery, validation, and takedown/disruption.
notable: Taken private by Haveli Investments (2024).

name: SOCRadar
one_line_description: Extended threat intelligence platform spanning CTI, brand protection, dark web, and external attack surface monitoring.
notable: Often cited as more accessible mid-market alternative to premium TIPs.

name: SpyCloud
one_line_description: Identity threat protection using recaptured dark-web/malware data with automated credential remediation integrations.
notable: Austin-based; focused on exposure-to-reset workflows vs full OSINT investigation UI.

name: ReliaQuest (Digital Shadows)
one_line_description: GreyMatter SOC platform incorporating Digital Shadows DRP for open/deep/dark-web digital risk monitoring.
notable: Digital Shadows acquired by ReliaQuest (2022; ~$160M reported).

name: Intelligence X
one_line_description: Selector-based search engine and historical archive across darknet, leaks, whois, and document-sharing sources.
notable: EU-based (Prague); privacy/EU-server positioning; founder Peter Kleissner.

name: Group-IB
one_line_description: Cybersecurity company offering threat intelligence, attack-surface, fraud, and digital-risk products.
notable: Global HQ moved to Singapore; regional HQ Dubai; Russian origins historically noted in coverage.

name: Censys
one_line_description: Internet intelligence platform for discovering exposed hosts, services, certificates, and attack-surface insights.
notable: Core internet-scan dataset widely used by security/OSINT practitioners.

name: Shodan
one_line_description: Search engine for internet-connected devices, services, banners, and vulnerabilities with monitoring/API.
notable: Iconic OSINT/recon tool; usage policies and OPSEC considerations for investigators.

name: DomainTools
one_line_description: DNS, WHOIS, passive DNS, and certificate intelligence for infrastructure-led investigations (Iris).
notable: Strong for domain pivoting and historical DNS evidence.

name: Netcraft
one_line_description: Phishing, scam, and malicious-site detection with takedown/disruption services.
notable: UK-based; long-running internet security research brand.

name: Sayari Graph
one_line_description: Corporate ownership, trade, and supply-network graph platform for due diligence and investigations.
notable: Washington DC HQ; complementary to classic SOCMINT tools.

name: Planet
one_line_description: Daily Earth observation constellation delivering near-daily revisit imagery for monitoring and change detection.
notable: Commercial GEOINT staple; free/limited access programs for some research/news use.

name: Vantor (formerly Maxar Intelligence)
one_line_description: Spatial intelligence company (formerly Maxar Intelligence) providing high-res satellite imagery and AI geospatial platform Tensorglobe.
notable: Rebranded from Maxar Intelligence to Vantor on 2025-10-01; Advent International PE-owned; Space Systems sibling rebranded Lanteris.

name: PimEyes
one_line_description: Face recognition search engine / reverse image search across publicly indexed face photos.
notable: Frequent privacy/ethics controversy; high OPSEC and legal-review priority for EU buyers.

name: Confidion Sentry
one_line_description: Enterprise OSINT/web-intel platform for entity profiles, watchlists, and real-time monitoring across web/social/dark web.
notable: Confidion Consulting & Technologies Inc., Halifax NS; Canadian-hosted; also offers Indicia screening.

name: Styx Intelligence
one_line_description: Digital risk platform combining AI monitoring (brand, exec, dark web) with analyst validation and takedowns.
notable: Vancouver BC HQ (777 Dunsmuir); Austin TX office; founded ~2020; Canadian DRP vendor.

name: Epieos
one_line_description: OSINT email/phone reverse-lookup tool mapping identifiers to social profiles without logging queries or notifying targets.
notable: Founded by Sylvain Hajri (2020 product; SAS registered Paris 2022); EU-hosted; free + private LE/pro tiers; claims no query logging.
